parameters.content:
## ⏳ FluxFilm expiry reminders — SETUP
**Every day 10:00 India time** it asks the shop which plans end in **3 days**, **today**, or **ended 1–2 days ago**, emails each customer once, and tells the shop it was sent (so nobody gets the same reminder twice).

1. Credentials → **Header Auth** named `FluxFilm n8n key`: Name `X-N8N-Key`, Value = the key from admin → 🔗 Integrations.
2. Credentials → **SMTP** named `SMTP FluxFilm (Gmail app password)` (smtp.gmail.com, port 465, SSL, your Gmail + app password) — or swap the Send Email node for Gmail.
3. In **Send reminder email** put your real sender in *From*.
4. Click **Execute workflow** once and check Executions. Then switch **Active** on.

The shop already skips refunded / cancelled / removed / renewed plans and customers who unsubscribed from reminder emails (their `email` is empty).
**Telegram** (owner summary) and **WhatsApp** nodes are *disabled*. WhatsApp: see docs/n8n/README.md before switching on (it needs the Cloud API and an approved template).
